title: Basic 认证头校验：凭据切分错位
prompt:
## 问题描述

内部服务的入口用 HTTP Basic 认证做校验。`auth.go` 里已有三个函数：`AuthorizationHeader` 生成请求头值，`Challenge` 生成 401 响应的 `WWW-Authenticate` 头值，`Authenticate(accounts Accounts, authorization string) (string, bool)` 校验收到的头值。`Authenticate` 当前的实现与下面这份契约不一致：有些合法凭据被拒，有些不该命中的账户反而被命中。请把它改对，函数签名保持不变。

契约：
1. 头值必须是 `Basic <base64>`：前缀是 6 个字符的 `"Basic "`（含结尾空格），比较时忽略大小写；长度不足、缺这个前缀、前缀不是 `Basic` 的一律不通过。
2. 前缀之后的部分必须能用标准 base64 解码，解码失败不通过。
3. 解码得到的字节串按 `账户名:口令` 解释：从**第一个**冒号处切开，冒号之前是账户名，冒号之后的整段（可以为空、可以含冒号与空格）是口令；找不到冒号则不通过。
4. 账户名必须存在于 `accounts`，且表里的口令与解析出的口令逐字节相等（区分大小写）。命中返回 `(账户名, true)`，其余一律返回 `("", false)`。
5. `accounts` 为 nil 或空时，任何头值都不通过。
`Challenge(realm)` 的格式是 `Basic realm=` 加上按 Go 引号规则转义后的 realm（realm 为空时取 `DefaultRealm`），`AuthorizationHeader` 是 `"Basic " + base64(user + ":" + password)`，这两个函数保持现有输出格式。

## 示例

```go
acc := Accounts{"ci-runner": "tok:en:99"}
Authenticate(acc, AuthorizationHeader("ci-runner", "tok:en:99")) // => ("ci-runner", true)
Authenticate(acc, AuthorizationHeader("ci-runner", "tok:en"))    // => ("", false)

Authenticate(Accounts{"ops": "pw"}, "basic "+b64("ops:pw"))   // => ("ops", true)，scheme 词大小写不敏感
Authenticate(Accounts{"ops": "pw"}, "Bearer "+b64("ops:pw"))  // => ("", false)
```

## 注意事项

- 只用 Go 标准库；所有文件都是 `package main` 且放在根目录；不要新增文件，也不要写 `func main`（入口在测试文件里）。
- `Accounts`、`DefaultRealm`、`basicScheme` 以及三个函数的名字与签名保持原样；判分只看这三个函数的返回值。
- 不要改 `AuthorizationHeader` 与 `Challenge` 的输出格式，测试按现有格式逐字符比对。
- 前缀之后的内容不做任何 trim：多一个空格就是另一份凭据；base64 部分也不做大小写折叠。

hidden.contents:
package main

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

// headerOf 直接按 user:password 原文拼出头值，绕过 AuthorizationHeader 以便构造异常输入。
func headerOf(payload string) string {
	return "Basic " + base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(payload))
}

func main() {
	pass, fail := 0, 0
	report := func(name string, ok bool, detail string) {
		if ok {
			pass++
			fmt.Printf("PASS %s\n", name)
		} else {
			fail++
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "FAIL %s: %s\n", name, detail)
		}
	}
	check := func(name string, accounts Accounts, header string, wantUser string, wantOK bool) {
		user, ok := Authenticate(accounts, header)
		report(name, user == wantUser && ok == wantOK,
			fmt.Sprintf("got (%q, %v), want (%q, %v)", user, ok, wantUser, wantOK))
	}

	got := AuthorizationHeader("admin", "password")
	report("header_shape", got == "Basic YWRtaW46cGFzc3dvcmQ=", fmt.Sprintf("got %q", got))

	got = Challenge("")
	report("challenge_default_realm", got == `Basic realm="Authorization Required"`, fmt.Sprintf("got %q", got))

	quotedRealm := `My "Realm"`
	got = Challenge(quotedRealm)
	quotePrefix := "Basic realm="
	suffix := strings.TrimPrefix(got, quotePrefix)
	unquoted, unquoteErr := strconv.Unquote(suffix)
	report("challenge_quoted_realm_roundtrip", unquoteErr == nil && unquoted == quotedRealm,
		fmt.Sprintf("got %q suffix %q err %v", got, suffix, unquoteErr))
	report("challenge_quoted_realm_escaped", len(got) == len(quotePrefix)+len(quotedRealm)+4,
		fmt.Sprintf("got %q len %d, want len %d", got, len(got), len(quotePrefix)+len(quotedRealm)+4))

	acc := Accounts{"admin": "password", "foo": "bar"}

	check("match_known_account", acc, AuthorizationHeader("foo", "bar"), "foo", true)
	check("reject_wrong_password", acc, AuthorizationHeader("foo", "baz"), "", false)
	check("reject_unknown_user", acc, AuthorizationHeader("root", "password"), "", false)

	check("accept_password_with_colon", Accounts{"admin": "pa:ss:1"},
		AuthorizationHeader("admin", "pa:ss:1"), "admin", true)
	check("reject_password_with_colon_mismatch", Accounts{"admin": "ss:1"},
		AuthorizationHeader("admin", "pa:ss:1"), "", false)
	check("split_at_first_colon_only", Accounts{"admin:pa": "ss"},
		headerOf("admin:pa:ss"), "", false)

	check("accept_empty_password", Accounts{"guest": ""}, AuthorizationHeader("guest", ""), "guest", true)
	check("password_is_case_sensitive", Accounts{"admin": "Password"},
		AuthorizationHeader("admin", "password"), "", false)

	check("password_trailing_space_matters", Accounts{"foo": "bar"},
		AuthorizationHeader("foo", "bar "), "", false)
	check("password_trailing_space_match", Accounts{"foo": "bar "},
		AuthorizationHeader("foo", "bar "), "foo", true)

	check("scheme_case_insensitive_lower", acc, "basic YWRtaW46cGFzc3dvcmQ=", "admin", true)
	check("scheme_case_insensitive_upper", acc, "BASIC YWRtaW46cGFzc3dvcmQ=", "admin", true)

	check("reject_other_scheme", acc, "Bearer YWRtaW46cGFzc3dvcmQ=", "", false)
	check("reject_empty_header", acc, "", "", false)
	check("reject_header_too_short", acc, "Basic", "", false)
	check("reject_missing_space_after_scheme", acc, "BasicYWRtaW46cGFzc3dvcmQ=", "", false)
	check("reject_double_space", acc, "Basic  YWRtaW46cGFzc3dvcmQ=", "", false)

	check("reject_invalid_base64", acc, "Basic !!!!", "", false)
	check("reject_payload_without_colon", acc, headerOf("admin"), "", false)
	check("reject_empty_payload", acc, "Basic ", "", false)

	check("reject_when_accounts_nil", nil, AuthorizationHeader("admin", "password"), "", false)
	check("reject_when_accounts_empty", Accounts{}, AuthorizationHeader("admin", "password"), "", false)

	fmt.Printf("TESTS %d %d\n", pass, fail)
	if fail > 0 {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

defect: Authenticate 用 LastIndexByte 从最后一个冒号切分 user:password，口令含冒号时既漏判合法凭据又误命中账户名里带冒号的条目；应按第一个冒号切分。

anchors.why: authorizationHeader 的 "Basic "+base64(user:pass) 头值构造形状
realm 默认值与 strconv.Quote 生成的 WWW-Authenticate 格式
searchCredential 逐条精确比对、未命中返回空串的语义
